entry.prompt: Charred dead tree: a thick blackened trunk splitting into four stout crooked bare limbs that reach up and out, broken stubby branch ends, no leaves, a burnt hollow at the foot, taller than wide. Low-poly game asset for a top-down strategy game, stylized painted realism that reads from above. Solid chunky closed volumes, thick limbs only, no twigs, hard edges, flat faces. One tree about 3.2 m tall. Isolated, no ground, no base plate, no text.
entry.texture: Stylized matte painted colours, even lighting, no baked shadows. Bark: charred charcoal grey-black (#35302E) with ash-grey highlights on the upper faces (#6E6660) so the limbs read against dark ground. Thin glowing ember-orange cracks (#E86A2A) in the trunk and the broken branch ends. No leaves, no flames, no text or logos.
